title: Payment Arrangements Quick Card — Grace Periods, Payment Tolerance, Re-presentment and Overpayments
content:
These are the collection figures of each type of Payment Arrangements: the grace period for a manually paid installment (calendar days after its due date before an unpaid installment is missed), the grace period for an automatic debit (calendar days after a failed debit before the installment is missed), the shortfall below which an installment still counts as paid, how many times and after how many business days a returned ACH installment may be presented again, and how a payment above the installment is applied.

## Grace and tolerance

| Arrangement type | Manual grace (calendar days) | Automatic-debit grace (calendar days) | Partial-payment tolerance (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Promise-to-Pay Arrangement | 0 | 0 | 0.00 |
| Short-Term Installment Plan | 5 | 3 | 2.00 |
| Standard Installment Plan | 5 | 5 | 5.00 |
| Extended Installment Plan | 0 | 7 | 5.00 |
| Long-Term Installment Plan | 0 | 7 | 5.00 |
| Hardship Reduced-Payment Plan | 10 | 10 | 5.00 |

The manual grace reads 0 on the Extended and Long-Term Installment Plans, which do not allow manual payment.

## Re-presentment and overpayments

| Arrangement type | ACH re-presentments per installment | Delay before re-presentment (business days) | Payment above the installment |
|---|---|---|---|
| Promise-to-Pay Arrangement | 1 | 2 | Reduces the remaining count |
| Short-Term Installment Plan | 2 | 3 | Reduces the remaining count |
| Standard Installment Plan | 2 | 3 | Reduces the remaining count |
| Extended Installment Plan | 2 | 3 | Advances the next due |
| Long-Term Installment Plan | 2 | 3 | Advances the next due |
| Hardship Reduced-Payment Plan | 2 | 5 | Advances the next due |

"Reduces the remaining count" applies the excess to the last installments so fewer remain; "advances the next due" applies it to the next installments in order so their due dates are already met.

## Hypothetical figures

- A Standard Installment Plan collected by automatic debit and a Short-Term Installment Plan paid manually both read a grace of 5 calendar days; the same Short-Term Installment Plan on automatic debit reads 3.
- On the Promise-to-Pay Arrangement the tolerance is 0.00, so an installment counts as paid only when the full amount has been applied.
